subject: english
question:
**Change the following from active to passive: **

The jury has delivered a unanimous verdict.

options.text: A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury.
A unanimous verdict was being delivered by the jury.
A unanimous verdict had been delivered by the jury.
A unanimous verdict is delivered by the jury.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To change a sentence from active to passive voice, the subject becomes the receiver of the action, and the object becomes the doer.
 
• The active sentence here is: **The jury has delivered a unanimous verdict.**
 
• In passive voice, the object ("a unanimous verdict") comes first, followed by the verb in the passive form. The subject ("the jury") follows, preceded by "by".
 
• The correct passive construction is: **A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury.**

Correct sentence: *A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active voice:** The subject performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
 
• **Example:** The chef prepared the meal.
 
 
 
• **Passive voice:** The subject receives the action expressed by the verb.
 
 
• **Example:** The meal was prepared by the chef.
 
 
 
• Verb tense in passive voice is formed by using the correct form of "to be" + the past participle of the main verb.
